title: WTO | Preferential Trade Arrangements
content:
WTO | Preferential Trade Arrangements WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Français Español Preferential Trade Arrangements Welcome to the Database on Preferential Trade Arrangements This database contains information on the preferential trade arrangements (PTAs) that are being implemented by WTO Members. 
								The database was established as an outcome of the decision establishing the Transparency Mechanism for PTAs .
								In the context of this decision, PTAs are understood to mean non-reciprocal preferential schemes.
								They are distinct from regional trade agreements (RTAs), which are covered by the Transparency Mechanism for RTAs .
								For further details on this database please consult the user guide and/or send an email to: [email protected] Find PTAs by country / territory List of all PTAs Find documentation About
